name: cable lateral step up
description: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.
